checks.name: blur
checks.rationale: Laplacian variance reached AUROC 1.000 on gaussian_blur in Stage 2. Note it is confounded upward by noise, which is why the composite score below does not rely on it alone.

checks.name: noise
checks.rationale: Noise estimate reached AUROC 0.999 on gaussian_noise in Stage 2.

checks.name: contrast
checks.rationale: Michelson contrast reached AUROC 0.971 on contrast_reduction.

checks.name: brightness
checks.rationale: Absolute deviation from a clean-image reference brightness. Raw mean intensity cannot be used because the injected offset is randomly signed.

checks.name: compression
checks.rationale: BRISQUE reached AUROC 0.976 on jpeg_compression, transferring to radiography better than its natural-scene-statistics basis predicts.

checks.name: motion_blur
checks.rationale: BRISQUE reached AUROC 0.982 on motion_blur in Stage 2.

checks.name: occlusion
checks.rationale: CLIP-IQA was the only scorer above chance on occlusion_patch (0.779). Every pixel-statistics metric was at or below chance, so this check is expected to be the weakest of the set.

checks.name: rotation
checks.rationale: Binary detection only. Rotation severity is not ordinal under SSIM (Sampat et al. 2009), so no severity is inferred for this check.

overall_check.name: overall_quality
overall_check.rationale: Logistic fusion of all IQA metrics and embedding detectors. On ChestX-ray14 this reached AUROC 0.915 against 0.817 for the best single scorer (paired bootstrap difference +0.098, 95% CI [+0.072, +0.122]).
